lines.text: For the next three minutes, there's nothing to do but notice. Let your eyes close.
Take one slow breath in... and let it go. Then let the breath do whatever it does on its own.
Rest your attention on the breath, wherever you feel it most.
When you hear this sound, take it as a reminder. If your mind has wandered, gently come back to the breath.
Your mind will wander. That's fine. Noticing that it wandered is the whole practice.
Let the practice go now. Notice how you feel. When you're ready, open your eyes.
